checks.detail: 35 (top) + 425 (door opening) + 30 (bottom rail) + 60 (leg ground clearance) = 550 mm. Also 35 (top) + 515 (leg/post) = 550 mm.

doubts: Page 1 technical requirement specifies 3-tier ball bearing drawer slides L300 W42mm ('Hộc kéo sử dụng ray trượt bi 3 tầng L300 bản rộng 42mm'), but unit is 4-door TV cabinet with no drawers; treated as generic template boilerplate.
Door height dimension shows 421 mm on page 2 front view elevation vs 420 mm on page 3 door detail drawing (1 mm discrepancy).
